events.team_completion_check: Completion check: assess remaining evidence gaps

title: AI agents
authorization: Agents use read operations: checked shell commands, HTTP GET/HEAD, approved MCP read tools and workflows checked at runtime. Writes are blocked; no per-call approval is shown.
mcpReadApprovalHint: Approve only reviewed, trusted read tools with appropriately restricted server access. The server annotation alone is not proof. Server configuration or tool schema changes require new approval. Apply with Save.
teamHint: This member receives the task first, assigns work to the others and combines their answers. Each team has exactly one lead.
removeSupervisorHint: Choose another member as team lead first.
minimumMembersHint: A team needs at least two members.
reviewerHint: Optional review function: Every selected reviewer must review the current work. Unanswered questions block successful completion. Select the team lead above.
singleBudgetHint: Defaults: 20 model calls, 40 tool calls, 20 minutes. Blank or zero timeout uses the configured default.
teamBudgetHint: Shared defaults: 100 model calls, 500 tool calls, 20 delegations, 30 minutes. Blank or zero timeout uses the configured default.
roleHint: Give this member a distinct name, such as Planner or Reviewer. You can use that name in your instructions. Choose the team lead separately above.
instructionsHint: Describe what should happen in your own words. NodePilot automatically provides the selected tools and how to use them.
supervisorInstructionsPlaceholder: Have the Planner draft a proposal and the Reviewer check it. Send the feedback back to the Planner for revision, then summarize the result.
instructionsPlaceholder: Describe this member's task, what to pay attention to and the result you expect.
delegationIncluded: Assigning work to team members and receiving their answers is available to the team lead automatically. Select any additional tools below.
activeProfile: Model from the active LLM profile
identityHint: Service identity requires an administrator's explicit opt-in. Otherwise a credential or machine default is required.
credentialRequired: Select a credential or configure a machine default.
noSkills: No packages registered. Administrators can import versioned ZIP packages in Settings → AI agents.
shellHint: PowerShell, CMD and Bash remain available for supported read commands with checked parameters. Writes, dynamic code and redirection are rejected. Skill scripts use the same checks; the target execution policy still applies.
allowedPaths: Allowed absolute paths, one per line
allowedHosts: Optional HTTP host restriction, one per line; empty = no additional list
workflowIds: Published workflow IDs, one per line
mcpServer: Add tools from an MCP server

toolHints.workflow_run: Run and await a selected published workflow.
toolHints.powershell: Execute a PowerShell command on the selected machine.
toolHints.cmd: Execute a CMD command on the selected machine.
toolHints.bash: Execute a command using an installed Git Bash.

modelMaxOutputTokens: Maximum output tokens per model call
maxContextCharacters: Input context (characters, separate from output tokens)
restartHint: Changing concurrency requires a server restart.
name: Name
secrets: Secrets as JSON (environment variables / HTTP headers)
secretsHint: Leave blank to keep stored secrets; {} clears them. Secrets are never returned.
deleteConfirm: Delete this registration? Workflows that reference it will fail until updated.
package: ZIP package with root SKILL.md (max. 10 MB)
registryHint: Only administrators can change registrations. Agent tool selections refer to fixed server and package IDs.
